content.short: iCrosschain enables cross-chain swaps with low fees and minimal slippage.
content.description: iCrosschain provides a cross-chain transaction service that lets you swap crypto assets across multiple blockchains with low fees and minimal slippage. Its core benefits include secure transaction execution and ultra-low costs, with a 0.2% cross-chain fee while gas fees and target-chain fees are charged by the respective chains. By leveraging its native cross-chain technology, iCrosschain reduces swap times from more than five minutes to a few seconds, signaling progress toward a second-level era in cross-chain transfers.
